heroLead: West Falls is a small community in Wyoming County, part of the northeastern dry gas corridor that Cabot and now Coterra have developed heavily over the years.
intro: Wyoming County doesn't get talked about as much as the counties further south, but it's been one of the most consistently active dry gas areas in the whole Marcellus play. West Falls sits inside that corridor, and if your family has held minerals here through the last fifteen years, you've likely seen a fairly steady, if unspectacular-sounding, run of royalty checks.
Steady isn't the same as simple, though, and we'll walk through what's actually driving your specific payments before we talk about buying your interest.

sections.heading: Wyoming County's Quiet Consistency
paragraphs: Operators in this corridor, historically Cabot Oil & Gas and now Coterra Energy following its merger, have run some of the most heavily developed dry gas units in the northeastern Marcellus. West Falls-area production has generally been steady rather than dramatic, which can make it easy to overlook how much value has actually accumulated in a long-held interest.
We pull the full production history tied to your unit, going back well beyond recent statements, to understand the true trajectory of your interest.

sections.heading: Small Community, Real Paperwork Complexity
paragraphs: Like a lot of small Wyoming County communities, mineral ownership near West Falls is often tied to older farm parcels that have been divided among heirs multiple times over. Confirming exactly what percentage you hold sometimes takes real work at the courthouse, especially if probate wasn't fully completed at some point along the way.
We handle that research as part of our review, so incomplete family paperwork doesn't stop you from getting a real answer about your interest's value.

sections.heading: Consistent Production, One-Time Payment
paragraphs: For owners tired of tracking a small, steady royalty check every month, or managing that responsibility on behalf of elderly parents, converting a long-running interest into a single payment can simplify things considerably. We'll show you the math either way, hold versus sell, so the decision is yours to make with real numbers in front of you.

faqs.question: Which companies operate near West Falls?
faqs.answer: Cabot Oil & Gas historically, and now Coterra Energy after its 2021 merger with Cimarex, have been the primary operators developing this corridor of Wyoming County.

faqs.question: My family's interest was split among heirs without a completed probate. Is that fixable?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. We can help identify what's needed to clear up an incomplete probate as part of the sale process, or work with the interest as-is depending on the situation.

faqs.question: Is Wyoming County gas production declining?
faqs.answer: Individual wells decline over time like any shale well, but the county as a whole has seen sustained development activity. We look at your specific unit's actual trend rather than a general county assumption.
